comment: ANCHOR: PACKET_VERIFY_SIGPIPE_20261022 — operator packet read-backs never pipe crontab -l into grep -q/head under pipefail: grep -q exits at the first match, crontab -l takes SIGPIPE (141), and pipefail reports a present line as missing (2026-10-22 incident-spcx resume run: every step applied, every verify printed FAILED). Runs the real verify blocks against a >200 KB fake crontab that dies on SIGPIPE, and lints every pipefail packet/ops script.
